title: Understanding Bootstrap Replicates
text: Bootstrap replicates are used to estimate the sampling distribution of a statistic by resampling with replacement from the original data. In this table, each row represents a bootstrap sample.

title: Analyzing the Table
text: The table shows replicates in columns and summary statistics in rows. The rowmeans, rowvars, and rowmedians are calculated for each row of replicates.

title: Effect of Increasing Replicates
text: Increasing the number of bootstrap replicates generally leads to a more accurate estimate of the sampling distribution, which can decrease the variance of the sample mean.
